notes: Five new in-season decisions with teeth: your agent calls about a bigger job (make calls quietly, stand down, or use it to ask the AD for an extension), TV wants to move your game to Friday night or an 11 a.m. kick, a team leader asks for a players-only meeting after a loss, a backup's dad threatens the portal unless his son starts, and academics flags a starter who could miss the postseason in December. Choices change your game edge next week, your budget, approval, promises, and the January portal. Up to five decisions a season now.
